# Side A 0.5.37
- With Codex's Approve for me on, the island no longer asks about commands Codex's own reviewer approves. Sessions started with `--yolo`, turns under strict auto-review, apps set to auto-review and administrator requirements are left to Codex too. - Codex edits get a This session button: later edits to the same files are allowed without asking again. - Claude requests that an SDK host or a background subagent settles first leave the island once the call is done. - Side A Remote (beta): pair the iPhone app to see and answer sessions, reply, switch accounts and run hosted sessions from your phone, on your network or through the relay. - The conversation viewer shows prompts typed while Claude was working, and opens conversations again with macOS's own Python. - Requests whose paths lead somewhere sensitive through a link, credential searches and more deletes need a click.
macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel. Free.
